intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetrySample without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Immutable record Telemetry Sample (one 1Hz data point): deviceId, metric, tDevice, tIngress, value, status. Invariants: all reference components non-null and deviceId non-blank (violations throw NullPointerException / IllegalArgumentException); the value is never altered or dropped, validation only replaces the status through withStatus. Record equality is by components.
